messages:
alex: Quick PSA — canary for v3.7.1 (quant kernels) is showing a 12% tail-latency regression on 8k-context workloads. Pausing releases for 24h to investigate. Details below.

maria: ugh. any idea of root cause?

alex: early signal points at the new quant kernel 0.9.2 combined with aggressive KV eviction heuristics. On A100s we see increased cache thrash. Repro steps in CI attached.

sanjay: can we rollback the kernel on canary nodes? if yes i'll queue it now.

alex: yes — plan:
1) rollback kernel to 0.9.1 on canary pool
2) re-run perf suite `./scripts/run_perf --suite=8k --retries=3`
3) monitor `infra/latency-tail` dashboard for 30m

release-bot: :information_source: Release freeze in effect for eng-release train for 24 hours. No merges to main which touch runtime/quant or serving/runtime-config. To request an exemption add label `freeze-exception` and ping @ops-oncall.

lina: customer impact?

alex: no external errors observed — routing policies already fallback to 3.6.x variants. We saw only internal perf regressions in canary traffic.

ops-oncall: I've bumped retention on the canary traces and enabled detailed kv cache logs. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/kv/kv-cache?orgId=1&from=now-1h

sanjay: rolling kernel rollback started on canary pool. command used:
```
ssh deploy@canary-1 "sudo package-manager install quant-kernel=0.9.1 && sudo systemctl restart redwood-inference"
```

maria: small ask — if you changed batching or cache knobs today, revert those too. We want a clean baseline.

alex: agreed. I'll collect a short changelog of anything touching runtime in the last 6 hours and post here.

alex: changelog (short):
- perf: quant kernel 0.9.2 (canary)
- infra: kv eviction heuristics tweak (auto)
- tests: added 8k stress suite

devops-bot: :white_check_mark: rollback completed on 3/3 canary nodes. Monitoring for 30m.

ops-oncall: if you see >5% tail-latency after rollback, escalate to #incidents and add `paging` label.

lina: thx. will retest our feature flags after monitoring window.

alex: thanks all — I'll hold the train and send a 1-line update in 30m with go/no-go. :thumbsup:
